purpose: Use already-consumed historical seasons only to select one architecture before spending the untouched 2025/26 PIT confirmation window.

source_contract.availability: vaastav/Fantasy-Premier-League Git history; current snapshot is latest valid pre-match snapshot with lead>=6h and staleness<=10d; previous is immediately preceding valid snapshot
source_contract.market: Football-Data E0 closing 1X2 retrospective market reference only; priority AvgC then B365C then MaxC then PSC; reciprocal no-vig normalization

candidate_set_frozen.definition: shock_score=sqrt(sum(Z(X1..X6)^2)); shock gate=training-fold 75th percentile computed without labels; fit separate fixed-offset draw logistic experts in calm and shock rows; prediction uses the deterministic gate; preserve market H:A ratio in 1-qD

fit separate one-vs-rest fixed-offset binary experts: draw uses Z(X1..X6) offset logit(market_pD); home uses Z(U1..U3) offset logit(market_pH); away uses Z(-U1..-U3) offset logit(market_pA); convert each expert logit to raw probability then normalize the three raw probabilities to sum 1

proper_score_gate: HDA LogLoss non-worse in at least 3 of 4 folds
natural_top1_gate: natural Top-1 Draw count >= max(10, ceil(0.01*pooled_test_n))
evaluation.selection: Only candidates passing both gates are eligible; select the one with lowest pooled HDA LogLoss. If none pass, select NONE and keep 2025/26 labels closed.

confirmation_protection.rule: No 2025/26 outcome/score access unless exactly one development winner is frozen in a separate confirmation preregistration before label opening.
